---
title: "Customer Segmentation — RFM Analysis"
author: "Shubham"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 3
    theme: cosmo
    highlight: tango
    number_sections: true
params:
  data_file: "data/cleaned_retail.csv"
  k_opt: 5
---

# Hide code/warnings/messages by default

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Libraries

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(factoextra)
library(cluster)
library(tidyr)
library(reshape2)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
library(knitr)

data <- read_csv(params$data_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
data$InvoiceDate <- as_datetime(data$InvoiceDate)

glimpse(data)
cat("Rows:", nrow(data), "Columns:", ncol(data), "\n")

top_products <- data %>%
group_by(Description) %>%
summarise(TotalSales = sum(TotalPrice, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
arrange(desc(TotalSales)) %>%
slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot(top_products, aes(x = reorder(Description, TotalSales), y = TotalSales)) +
geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
coord_flip() +
labs(title = "Top 10 Selling Products", x = "Product", y = "Total Sales") +
theme_minimal()

country_sales <- data %>%
group_by(Country) %>%
summarise(TotalSales = sum(TotalPrice, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
arrange(desc(TotalSales)) %>%
slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot(country_sales, aes(x = reorder(Country, TotalSales), y = TotalSales)) +
geom_col(fill = "seagreen") +
coord_flip() +
labs(title = "Top 10 Countries by Sales", x = "Country", y = "Total Sales") +
theme_minimal()

snapshot_date <- max(data$InvoiceDate, na.rm = TRUE) + days(1)

rfm <- data %>%
group_by(CustomerID) %>%
summarise(
Recency = as.numeric(difftime(snapshot_date, max(InvoiceDate), units = "days")),
Frequency = n_distinct(InvoiceNo),
Monetary = sum(TotalPrice, na.rm = TRUE),
.groups = "drop"
)

summary(rfm)

# log transform monetary

rfm <- rfm %>% mutate(Monetary_log = log1p(Monetary))

# scale features

rfm_scaled <- scale(rfm %>% select(Recency, Frequency, Monetary_log))

set.seed(123)
p_elbow <- fviz_nbclust(rfm_scaled, kmeans, method = "wss") + ggtitle("Elbow Method (WSS)")
p_sil <- fviz_nbclust(rfm_scaled, kmeans, method = "silhouette") + ggtitle("Silhouette Method")

print(p_elbow)
print(p_sil)

k_opt <- params$k_opt
set.seed(42)
kmeans_model <- kmeans(rfm_scaled, centers = k_opt, nstart = 100, iter.max = 200)
rfm$Cluster <- factor(kmeans_model$cluster)

rfm_summary <- rfm %>%
group_by(Cluster) %>%
summarise(
Avg_Recency = round(mean(Recency), 1),
Avg_Frequency = round(mean(Frequency), 2),
Avg_Monetary = round(mean(Monetary), 2),
Count = n(),
.groups = "drop"
) %>%
arrange(as.integer(Cluster))

rfm_summary

# Rank clusters by Avg_Monetary and map to readable names

ranked <- rfm_summary %>% arrange(desc(Avg_Monetary)) %>% mutate(Rank = row_number())

# Default labels; you can edit if you used a different number of clusters

labels <- c("VIP", "Loyal", "Occasional", "At-Risk", "Low-Value")
labels_use <- labels[1:nrow(ranked)]
label_map <- setNames(labels_use, ranked$Cluster)
rfm$Segment <- unname(label_map[as.character(rfm$Cluster)])

rfm_summary_labeled <- rfm %>%
group_by(Segment) %>%
summarise(
Avg_Recency = round(mean(Recency), 1),
Avg_Frequency = round(mean(Frequency), 2),
Avg_Monetary = round(mean(Monetary), 2),
Count = n(),
.groups = "drop"
) %>%
arrange(desc(Avg_Monetary))

rfm_summary_labeled

pca <- prcomp(rfm_scaled, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_df <- data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[,1], PC2 = pca$x[,2], Segment = rfm$Segment)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Segment)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
labs(title = "Customer Segments (PCA Projection)") +
theme_minimal() +
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2")

centroids <- as.data.frame(kmeans_model$centers)
centroids$Cluster <- paste0("Cluster_", 1:nrow(centroids))
cent_m <- pivot_longer(centroids, cols = -Cluster, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Value")

ggplot(cent_m, aes(x = Feature, y = Cluster, fill = Value)) +
geom_tile() +
scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
labs(title = "Cluster Centroid Heatmap (Scaled Features)", x = "Feature", y = "Cluster") +
theme_minimal() +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

ggplot(rfm, aes(x = Frequency, y = Monetary, color = Segment)) +
geom_jitter(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.6) +
labs(title = "Customer Segments: Frequency vs Monetary",
x = "Frequency (Distinct Invoices)",
y = "Monetary (Total Spend)") +
theme_minimal() +
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2")

knitr::kable(rfm_summary_labeled, caption = "Segment Summary (Labeled)")

dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(rfm, "output/customer_segments_labeled.csv")
write_csv(rfm_summary_labeled, "output/rfm_cluster_summary_labeled.csv")
cat("Saved labeled customers and summaries to 'output/'\n")
